probes.question: Roughly how many digits does the largest known prime have?
The prime was found by the Great Internet ____ Prime Search (GIMPS).

image.alt: Flat illustration of a grid of teal dots with a single orange dot standing out.

body.claim: As of October 2026, the largest known prime number is 2^136,279,841 − 1, which has 41,024,320 digits.
body.why: It is a Mersenne prime (one less than a power of two), found on 12 October 2024 on a cloud computer volunteered by Luke Durant to GIMPS, a project of volunteers who search for these primes. Mersenne numbers have a fast special test, the Lucas-Lehmer test, which makes giant ones checkable.
